notes: Blocks and all loop/jump forms share full expression contexts; do-while consumes only an explicit trailing semicolon, preserving the adjacent-statement boundary.
Switch clauses, try/catch/finally, throw ASI, debugger, expression statements, and labels preserve exact missing-node and diagnostic ranges.
Contextual declaration detection retains line-break and export-type lookahead rollback; import/export terminal forms are handled by the module parser.
Object/array patterns, rest/default/elision, private-name errors, for initializer contexts, and var/let/const/using/await-using flags match upstream.
Leading/trailing decorators and contextual modifiers preserve token boundaries and ordering, including export-default-abstract and ambient modifier flags.
Async/generator/type parameters, overload semicolons, return types, block bodies, and ambient context share the expression function-body parser.
Constructors, methods, accessors, fields, auto-accessors, index signatures, private/computed names, static blocks, and parser-retained invalid type fields are covered.
Class declarations and expressions share full members, decorators, extends/implements clauses, instantiation expressions, and exact list metadata.
Interfaces, aliases, enums, dotted namespaces, string modules, global augmentation, declaration-file ambient context, and nested statement lists match parser behavior.
